decisions.reason: The source specifies the separate J_DISP_LED e-paper backlight circuit, not the SK6812 addressable LED power or data interface.
The e-paper backlight specification does not change the passive buzzer part or electrical interface.
GPIO42 PWM and the backlight boot-off behavior do not alter the panel reset connector or EN-to-GND action.
The BSS138 is specified as a low-side LED switch, not as a sensor logic-level shifter, so the sensor compatibility policy remains unchanged.
The J_DISP_LED circuit does not change the panel buttons, slide switch, their GPIO assignments, or connector mounting.
The source does not modify the PIR connector or its digital input interface.
J_DISP_LED is an e-paper backlight interface and does not alter the sensor-board connector matrix.
The backlight PWM and power-selection details do not change either capacitive-touch connector or GPIO assignment.
The source concerns an LED backlight and does not change the SPS30 SEL connection or I2C operating mode.
The current backlight build selects 5V, while the unpopulated 3V3 jumper is only a future fallback; the source does not require adding the backlight to the standalone USB 3.3V load set.
The external e-paper backlight on J_DISP_LED is distinct from the eight-SK6812 addressable LED array board.
The approximately 70mA backlight estimate does not change the requirement to monitor both the 3.3V and 5V rails or its current monitoring architecture.
